target.statement: DC-MK-means DPD achieves trimmed R2 = 0.672 (highest among compared methods) on the Covid-19 country dataset
target.dataset: Covid-19 country-level CFR/infection-rate + demographic data (Kaggle 'countries of the world')

compute.basis: No code released; the full MK-means DPD / DC-MK-means DPD pipeline (core-point initialization, iterative weighted DPD estimation with BFGS/Armijo fallback, robust DBIM/CHItrim indexes) must be reimplemented from the paper's equations, and the exact Kaggle data version/cleaning and alpha choice are unspecified, so most of the effort is code writing plus tuning rather than raw compute.

blockers: exact data preprocessing, alpha tuning parameter, and cluster count selection not fully specified
robust internal indexes (DBIM, CHItrim) must be reimplemented from prose
